nairobi-national-park.name: Nairobi National Park
nairobi-national-park.price_text: ≈ KES 4,300 non-resident adult per day; child rate lower. Check current KWS rates.
nairobi-national-park.hours: Daily roughly 06:00–18:00; gates close in the evening
nairobi-national-park.tip: Go at opening time for the best game viewing and to beat the heat. Bring your passport for the gate.

giraffe-centre.name: Giraffe Centre
giraffe-centre.price_text: ≈ KES 1,500 non-resident adult; child rate lower. Check on the day.
giraffe-centre.tip: You can hand-feed the giraffes from a raised platform. Go early before tour buses arrive.

karen-blixen.name: Karen Blixen Museum
karen-blixen.price_text: ≈ KES 1,500 non-resident adult. Check on the day.
karen-blixen.tip: The house tour takes about an hour. Combine it with the Giraffe Centre nearby.

national-museum.name: Nairobi National Museum
national-museum.price_text: ≈ KES 1,500 non-resident adult. Check on the day.
national-museum.tip: Start with the human origins gallery. The snake park next door costs extra.

bomas-of-kenya.name: Bomas of Kenya
bomas-of-kenya.price_text: ≈ KES 1,500 non-resident adult for the dance show. Check on the day.
bomas-of-kenya.hours: Shows usually weekday afternoons; confirm times when booking
bomas-of-kenya.tip: The traditional dance show is the main draw. Check show times before you travel across town.

kicc.name: Kenyatta International Convention Centre
kicc.price_text: ≈ KES 500 to go up the tower. Check on the day.
kicc.tip: The rooftop helipad gives a 360° view over the city. Go on a clear morning.

august-7th-memorial.name: August 7th Memorial Park
august-7th-memorial.price_text: Small entry fee, around KES 300. Check on the day.
august-7th-memorial.tip: A quiet memorial to the 1998 US embassy bombing. Allow 30–45 minutes.

jamia-mosque.name: Jamia Mosque
jamia-mosque.hours: Outside prayer times; check on the day
jamia-mosque.tip: Dress modestly and ask before entering. Women cover hair.

luna-park.name: Luna Park (Nairobi)
luna-park.price_text: Pay per ride; prices vary. Check on the day.
luna-park.hours: Daily, mostly afternoon into evening; confirm
luna-park.tip: A simple family funfair. Check it is open before making a special trip.

railway-museum.name: Nairobi Railway Museum
railway-museum.price_text: ≈ KES 500 non-resident adult. Check on the day.
railway-museum.tip: Old locomotives and railway history in the yard. Good for an hour.

nairobi-river.name: Nairobi River
nairobi-river.hours: Always open; walk in daylight only
nairobi-river.tip: The river runs through the city centre. Walk with a guide and stay in busy areas.

nyama-choma.name: Nyama Choma
nyama-choma.price_text: ≈ KES 500–1,500 per person depending on meat and sides
nyama-choma.hours: Mostly lunch and evening; varies by restaurant
nyama-choma.tip: Grilled meat eaten with ugali and kachumbari. Ask for the price per kilo before ordering.

splash-waterworld.name: Splash Waterworld (Nairobi)
splash-waterworld.price_text: Entry fee varies; check on the day.
splash-waterworld.tip: A water park for families. Bring swimwear and sun protection.

uhuru-gardens.name: Uhuru Gardens
uhuru-gardens.price_text: Small entry fee, around KES 300. Check on the day.
uhuru-gardens.tip: A large memorial park with the independence monument. Good for a relaxed walk.

maasai-market.name: Maasai Market (craft market)
maasai-market.hours: Moves between sites by day; check on the day
maasai-market.tip: A roving craft market for souvenirs. Bargain politely and start low.

karura-forest.name: Karura Forest
karura-forest.price_text: ≈ KES 600 non-resident adult. Check on the day.
karura-forest.tip: Walking and cycling trails plus a waterfall. Bring water and go with a friend.

kibera-tour.name: Kibera community walk
kibera-tour.price_text: ≈ KES 1,500–3,000 with a local guide; confirm what is included
kibera-tour.tip: Go only with a reputable local guide and ask where the fee goes.

westlands-walk.name: Westlands food and bar walk
westlands-walk.tip: An easy evening area for restaurants and bars. Use a ride-hailing app after dark.

ngong-hills-view.name: Ngong Hills viewpoint
ngong-hills-view.price_text: Park fees vary; check on the day
ngong-hills-view.tip: A ridge walk with wide views over the Rift Valley. Take a jacket; it can be windy and cool.

city-centre-walk.name: City Centre heritage walk
city-centre-walk.price_text: Free to walk; guided tours cost extra
city-centre-walk.tip: See colonial-era buildings around the CBD. Keep valuables out of sight and walk in daytime.
